question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom given in bold in the following sentence.**

The memory of all that blood was enough **to make my flesh crawl**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **frightened me**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom "**to make my flesh crawl**" means to make someone feel disgusted, afraid, etc. (किसी को घृणा, भय आदि महसूस कराना)

 
 
• Example - *The memory of all that blood was enough to make my flesh crawl.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "to make my flesh crawl" is "frightened me"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
